alias_rule: Count one physical allocation once; actual copies each once. Phase peaks use union of all live resources.
capacity_basis: Physical totals measured by T00. Reserves exactly preserve validation-policy; external allocations are excluded once, never double charged.
policy_change_boundary: new request or reviewed quiescent boundary; live lease addresses cannot move
advance_admission: Reserve all state/verify/loop writes with checked integer arithmetic before launch; no partial state commit on failure.
retirement_rule: Transfer completion AND all readers complete; cancellation after issue does not imply retirement; generation must match.

prefetch_policy.belady_scope: offline miss-count lower bound / avoidable-eviction-miss improvement upper bound; not stall or prefetch latency bound

mapping_rule: resource_id + view_generation maps to exactly one physical_allocation and byte range. location_domain equals physical_allocation.medium. Views share a physical key; actual copies have distinct keys. Arena generation is independent. Reassigning a subrange increments view_generation even if physical allocation and arena do not change. Cache bindings describe producer evidence, not restorable pointers; restored resources receive fresh bindings.
